OK.title: Provider ready
steps: No setup action is needed. Choose the provider explicitly for optional tests.
OK.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

WSB_CLI_MISSING.title: Sandbox CLI missing
WSB_CLI_MISSING.why: wsb.exe is absent or cannot be found; older Windows builds may have the Sandbox desktop without this CLI.
steps: Check the Windows edition and install current Windows updates. Windows Home does not support Sandbox.
On a supported edition, enable Sandbox in administrator PowerShell: Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Containers-DisposableClientVM -All
Restart if Windows requests it; confirm virtualization is enabled in BIOS/UEFI.
Verify the CLI: wsb list --raw
WSB_CLI_MISSING.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

WSB_FEATURE_DISABLED.title: Sandbox feature disabled
WSB_FEATURE_DISABLED.why: The structured Windows feature probe reports Sandbox is disabled.
steps: Enable Sandbox in administrator PowerShell: Enable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Containers-DisposableClientVM -All
Restart Windows after enabling the feature; confirm virtualization is enabled in BIOS/UEFI.
Verify: wsb list --raw
WSB_FEATURE_DISABLED.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

WSB_UNSUPPORTED_EDITION.title: Sandbox unavailable on this edition
WSB_UNSUPPORTED_EDITION.why: The Windows operating system SKU identifies a Home edition, which does not support Sandbox.
steps: Use a supported Windows edition if you need Sandbox security isolation.
For Linux compatibility tests, check WSL instead: wsl --version
WSL2 is not a security substitute for Sandbox; Windows interop and network access remain.
WSB_UNSUPPORTED_EDITION.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

WSL_NOT_INSTALLED.title: Install or enable WSL
WSL_NOT_INSTALLED.why: wsl.exe is missing or returned the HRESULT for a missing WSL optional component.
steps: Install WSL without a user distribution in administrator PowerShell: wsl --install --no-distribution
Restart if requested and confirm virtualization is enabled in BIOS/UEFI.
Update WSL: wsl --update
Verify: wsl --version
WSL_NOT_INSTALLED.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

WSL_PROBE_FAILED.title: WSL probe failed
WSL_PROBE_FAILED.why: WSL could not complete its version/status probes; this may be transient or an older WSL installation.
steps: Retry: wsl --version
Update WSL: wsl --update
If WSL is not installed, use administrator PowerShell: wsl --install --no-distribution
Complete any requested restart and check BIOS/UEFI virtualization.
Retry: engram isolation check
WSL_PROBE_FAILED.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.

PROBE_ERROR.title: Provider probe failed
PROBE_ERROR.why: A probe failed or returned invalid structured data; the cause is not known.
steps: Retry: engram isolation check
Check Sandbox: wsb list --raw
Check WSL: wsl --version
Check pending Windows restarts, Windows updates, and BIOS/UEFI virtualization.
PROBE_ERROR.without_it: Engram open, doctor, updates, and ordinary host workflows still work; another available provider can be selected explicitly.
